leadText: Rock-A-Bye Pokémon (Part 1) (Japanese: アーモンドを救え！！ (前編) Save Almond! (Part 1)), is the sixth chapter of the seventh volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.
plainText:
Rock-A-Bye Pokémon (Part 1) (Japanese: アーモンドを救え！！ (前編) Save Almond! (Part 1)), is the sixth chapter of the seventh volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Almond is in a deep sleep and won't wake up! Hazel and Coconut vow to get to the bottom of the problem.

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Hazel
Coconut
Almond

In the Chuang Yi translation, on the title page of this chapter, "Pokémon" is mis-spelled as "Pokémnon".
